prompt_short: My schema.json has a lot of null concept_ids and low confidence scores. How do I fix

assertions.text: Response describes the classification review workflow (one family at a time approach)
assertions.evidence: Response explicitly states 'the right approach here is the classification review workflow' and instructs to 'Pick one repeated family of fields' with a loop: 'pick family → inspect evidence → smallest rule change → scoped rerun → compare → next family'.

assertions.text: Response does NOT tell the user to simply rerun source_system_analyzer.py from scratch
assertions.evidence: Response explicitly says 'not a full rerun of the analyzer. A full rerun won't improve things unless you've already changed the underlying rules.' No instruction to rerun from scratch is given.

assertions.text: Response mentions bucketing or grouping nulls/low-confidence columns before rerunning
assertions.evidence: Step 1 instructs the user to 'Triage your schema.json into three buckets': false positives, high-value nulls, and low confidence — explicitly grouping nulls and low-confidence fields before any rerun.
